product_metadata.title: 1 X Mason's Jars Box Salt and Pepper Caddy with Wood Handle
features: Charming metal Mason jar salt and pepper shaker caddy.
Glass salt and pepper shakers with the classic Mason jar logo printed on both sides.
A wooden handle adds a rustic touch.
Rustic finish on caddy to go with any decor.
description: This charming Mason jar caddy measures 4 inches wide, 2 inches deep and 5 inches high. This metal caddy holds one salt and pepper shaker set with the classic Mason jar logo printed on the front. A wooden handle adds a rustic touch. Salt and pepper shakers are included.
